item.title: Write the Cleanup Headline

turns.text: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly illustrated seaside scene, with a short catchy headline — you pick the words. No dates or signup details.

item.tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.

turns.text: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Use a friendly illustrated seaside scene with a short, catchy headline—you pick the words. No dates or signup details. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **one 640 × 640 image using Flux Schnell, starting at 5 credits** on the free plan. I haven’t run anything or spent any credits. I can’t verify the final charge or your remaining balance with the tools available here.

My proposed design:
- Friendly illustrated beach with smiling volunteers collecting litter, gentle waves, and a sunny sky
- Headline: **“Small Acts. Cleaner Shores.”**
- Small supporting line: “Help clean up your local beach.”
- No dates or signup details

**Ways to save:** Stick with one image at 640px—the smallest supported free-plan size—and skip variations or upscaling. A shorter headline won’t lower the image-generation cost. A text-only design brief costs no Magic Hour credits.

Would you like me to proceed with the **starting-at-5-credit option**, or keep it to a free design brief?

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account doesn’t have enough credits. **No image was generated and no credits were spent.** I won’t try another generation.

The no-credit alternative is to build this in a free design editor:

- **Canvas:** 640 × 640 square
- **Scene:** Friendly illustrated volunteers collecting litter beside gentle waves
- **Colors:** Seafoam, sky blue, sandy cream, and coral
- **Headline:** “Small Acts. Cleaner Shores.”
- **Supporting line:** “Help clean up your local beach.”

There’s no download link because the generation didn’t run.

args.name: Small Acts Cleaner Shores — Beach Cleanup

style.prompt: Create a square social media graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly polished seaside illustration with warm sunshine, gentle blue waves, sandy beach, coastal grasses, and a few smiling volunteers picking up small pieces of litter into reusable cleanup bags. Cheerful inclusive community atmosphere, inviting rather than preachy, clean flat vector-inspired illustration with soft organic shapes, warm coral accents and seafoam turquoise blues. Strong balanced graphic design with generous clean space for crisp highly legible typography. Include exactly this large catchy headline: "Small Acts. Cleaner Shores." Include exactly this smaller supporting line: "Help clean up your local beach." No other text, no dates, no signup details, no logos. Make the headline dominant and easy to read at small social media sizes. Square composition.
